text: この　くやしさを　わすれず　しゅぎょうに　はげむのじゃー！

structure.jp: この　くやしさを　わすれず
しゅぎょうに　はげむのじゃー！

patterns.name: 〜ずに
patterns.explanation: ず on a verb means 'without doing' it, a slightly old-fashioned form of ないで. The に is left off here. わすれず = 'without forgetting'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のじゃ is the old-man form of のだ. Said to someone about what they should do, it works as a firm order. はげむのじゃー = 'you are to work hard at it!'.
